what: Multiple photos covering the panel switch every 10 seconds — the next slide starts at 1.4x and transparent, then comes in to 1.25x and opaque over 2s (ease), while the current slide keeps its size and fades out over the same 2s. A slide that was turned off earlier returns to 1.4x without a transition and waits for its next turn. The first slide turns on the same way after all images have loaded (window load)

options.to: Scale of the active sheet, default 1.25 (original phone 1.3)
options.[data-fx-part=slide]: Direct child of the panel — photo, video or graphic slot (at least one)

from.where: index.html hero .np-movie (original #home-main #movie img — outer scale(1.4) opacity 0, .actImg scale(1.25) opacity 1 transition 2s, .actImg.actImg2 opacity 0, setInterval 10000. On a phone .actImg is scale(1.3))
